title: Ultra Hearty Australian Beef Stew
description: A rich and satisfying one-pot dish featuring tender beef and deep-fried potatoes in a flavorful tomato broth, this stew is perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Deep-fry the potatoes in hot oil until crispy, then drain on paper towels.
Add the browned beef, diced tomatoes, beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Add the deep-fried potatoes to the stew and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
